_provenance: PLACEHOLDER VALUES. These are archetypes, not surveyed sites. Footfall, stop rates, segment mixes, rents, and commissions were guessed to give the simulation contrasting choices. The City of Toronto publishes pedestrian counts as open data; use those to calibrate base_footfall before trusting any comparison between locations. Whether a machine may stand on a public sidewalk at all is a bylaw question this file does not answer. See notes/source-verification.md.

notes.stop_rate: Share of passers-by who stop at a fully stocked, varied machine.
notes.weather_exposure: 0 = fully indoor, 1 = fully exposed to weather.
notes.monthly_rent: Flat fee to the host or permit holder, CAD per month.
notes.commission_rate: Share of net sales paid to the host.
notes.vandalism_rate: Daily probability the machine is put out of service by damage.
